prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph at night inside a shabby English lettings office after closing, a single flickering fluorescent tube overhead throwing cold teal light. The whole back wall, floor to ceiling and receding down a long corridor into darkness, is pegboard hung with thousands upon thousands of identical brass Yale-style house keys on small paper tags, each one for a house nobody lives in, dust on the tags, keys untouched for months. At the bottom of the frame, on a worn grey carpet tile, one small cardboard box of a few keys, lit brighter, looking tiny against the wall. No people. Cheap colour negative film, grain, slight green-teal cast, lonely and eerie. Thanks.
